fusions.name: Combing Gulp
fusions.desc: Draws a cone of water through your baleen, dealing 7 damage to everything caught in it. Each hit has a 30% chance of [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Snarled Lash
fusions.desc: A lash of fringe that deals 12 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Bristling Fringe
fusions.desc: For 8 seconds, 40% of the damage you take is dealt back to whoever dealt it.

fusions.name: Filtered Blows
fusions.desc: When a blow that is not fire hurts you, you gain a ward worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
